market_scope.summary: HelloGrowthCRM is sold worldwide with country-aware pricing. India is billed in INR; every other market is billed in USD or its local currency.
market_scope.india: India: Growth is INR 899 per user per month plus 18% GST, billed in INR (UPI, Razorpay, net banking, card).
market_scope.outside_india: Outside India: Growth is USD 12 per user per month on monthly billing, with a lower per-month rate on yearly billing. Local-currency prices exist for the UK (GBP), Canada (CAD), Australia (AUD), UAE (AED), Singapore (SGD) and New Zealand (NZD).
market_scope.yearly_discount: Yearly billing is discounted in every market (India: two months free).
market_scope.more: Call pricing_get_country_plans for each market's currency, payment methods and compliance posture, countries_list for the 8 localized hubs, and country_get for one market's profile.
